fichas.title: Conversion Factors
fichas.summary: Reference table of conversion factors between metric and imperial/US units. It covers fuel consumption, acceleration, temperature, temperature interval, energy, power, heat-flow intensity, thermal conductivity, thermal conductance, thermal resistivity, specific heat capacity, specific energy, refrigeration, illumination, luminance, force, force per unit length, moment of force (torque), and pressure. Refer to the printed table on page 559 for the listed values; conversion entries are not reproduced as architectural dimensions.
